answer: Capability-token burn. Each epoch the beacon mints one velvet HMAC token per registered key. Submitting an answer burns that exact token; reuse from any second address zeros both payees for 8 epochs. A sable farm of 1,000 clone keys holds only as many tokens as registered heads, so idle clones earn nothing. The ember of reward stays with keys that present a fresh, unspent token at submit time. Publish per-close burn logs so auditors can count reused tokens.
